title: Lakeside Bungalow
description:
Escape to this beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom bungalow with a cozy sleeping nook, nestled on 2 peaceful acres just minutes from Old Hickory Lake! This comfortable countryside retreat is perfect for families, small groups, fishing trips, or Nashville weekend getaways. You’ll enjoy the quiet of the country while being only about 30 minutes from Nashville.
Spend the day boating on the lake, exploring or relaxing under the stars, this property is a peaceful home base for your trip.

The space
Beds are 1 King size bed in one room, 2 queen size beds in one room, and 1 twin size bed in the nook.

Other things to note
Please bring a bag of ice for freezer because refrigerator does not produce ice. 

We do have PUR water filter to use in the fridge.
